title: License Obligation Gate
intent: Block reuse until license permissions and obligations are explicit.
problem: Without permission class and obligations select the reuse route, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the license obligation gate contract.
context: This pattern addresses third-party material may be incorporated; its concrete control is permission class and obligations select the reuse route.
forces: Correctness requires that unknown licenses never enter direct reuse
Operational pressure can cause: a permissive label lacks supporting evidence
solution: Implement permission class and obligations select the reuse route. Verify the anchored symbol `LearningSafetyViolation` with `test_scanner_blocks_secret_and_pii_without_returning_source` before reuse.
invariants: unknown licenses never enter direct reuse
attribution and share-alike duties remain attached
failure_modes: a permissive label lacks supporting evidence
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `a permissive label lacks supporting evidence` and fails closed if the license obligation gate evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For license obligation gate, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to permission class and obligations select the reuse route.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: third-party material may be incorporated
Do not apply when: only internal proprietary code is involved
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
not_when: only internal proprietary code is involved
